t: Twin or Twin XL: How to Buy the Right Size of Bed
s: July 24, 2025 - This means that a twin XL is generally better for taller people. Beyond that, there is no difference in the 38-inch width measurement, meaning both bed sizes are best suited for single sleepers. It comes down to a small difference in length. Twin beds are perfect for single sleepers, and as Sleep Expert® John McCarty explains, “many parents buy them for their children, for bunk bed setups.” Twin XL beds, on the other hand, are ideal for taller individuals and young adults—which is why they've become the go-to bed for college dorms.
